label: Controls for the nine-restricted self-operation premises, checked
meaning: Strictness: a pure act without intellect and without immanent operation or life (and so without the nine) satisfies both nine-restricted premises and falsifies STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES and STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES, so the weak versions do not entail the strong ones. Nonvacuity: some being has the nine and lives at some time. Intellect bridge: the nine-restricted life premise and the restricted sense bridge hold where an intellectual pure act is not LIVING_1, so these two premises do not entail 'Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 lives', not even restricted to pure acts; the other premises of the routes are not checked in this model, so no claim is made about the full bundle. Sense mixing fails without the bridge: a being with the nine can be LIVING_2 and not LIVING_1, so the weak life premise alone does not give the living conjunct. Model-witnessed facts about these interpretations only; the pure act without intellect shows where each strong version is needed, not that any being is such a pure act.
